title: Rainforest Rhythm ABC
hook: Layer by layer, the rainforest keeps time.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of quiet after cue
visualStyle: lush friendly 3D rainforest storybook, emerald leaves, bright fruit and animals, clean separated foregrounds, no clutter

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child listening to different rainforest layers as separate parts of one restrained rhythm
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: reassemble drip, rustle, wing and hush without covering learning words
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: syncopated but gentle 4/4 with wet-leaf rests
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written sensory lines; only truthful sounds become percussion and silent targets get visual or tactile rests
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: rhythm cue -> recall beat -> target -> one safe motion
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Build a rainforest rhythm from honest layers of water, leaf movement, wingbeats, calls and silence so the child hears an ecosystem instead of a generic jungle beat.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A listener follows drip, rustle, flutter, call, splash and hush from wet ground to canopy; silent plants become rests in the rhythm.
semanticArc: color and calls widen the canopy
waterfall gathers the rhythm and releases it
forbiddenGenericLanguage: jungle words bounce back to me
